warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Cheap frontline melee. The backbone of an early army and the only unit most players can afford on turn one.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Hits hard but folds under a counter-attack. Best kept behind a Warrior.

horseman.name: Horseman
horseman.description: Fast flanker that cannot climb mountains. Punishes undefended territory.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.description: Siege engine built to crack cities. Nearly helpless if caught in the open.

trireme.name: Trireme
trireme.description: Controls the lake. Cannot leave water, but nothing crosses without answering to it.

submarine.name: Submarine
submarine.description: Runs silent beneath the surface. Strikes first and hard, but cannot take a hit.

skimmer.name: Sky Skimmer
skimmer.description: Fast, fragile scout. Bought to see, not to fight - the cheapest way to burn off fog.

airship.name: Airship
airship.description: The workhorse gunship of the sky lanes. Solid attack, solid armour, no bad matchups.

dropship.name: Dropship
dropship.description: Armoured transport that can descend to the surface at a transition point. Almost no attack - it exists to move and survive.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.description: Aerial artillery. Devastating from above and slow to reposition.

tunneler.name: Tunneler
tunneler.description: Subterranean transport that surfaces at transition points. Tough, but a poor attacker.

dire_bat.name: Dire Bat
dire_bat.description: Boils out of the caves and into the sky. The only unit that scouts two layers.

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.description: Its gaze turns the tunnels to stone. Slow, blind above ground, lethal below it.

stone_golem.name: Stone Golem
stone_golem.description: Quarried, not born. The hardest thing to shift out of a tunnel in the game.

cave_wyrm.name: Cave Wyrm
cave_wyrm.description: The deep's apex predator. Hits harder than anything else in the world and costs accordingly.
